faqs.question: What is the cashback rate on the SBI Cashback Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The SBI Cashback Credit Card offers 5% cashback on eligible online spends and 1% cashback on eligible offline purchases. Both are capped per statement cycle.

faqs.question: What is the maximum cashback I can earn?
faqs.answer: You can earn up to ₹4,000 cashback per statement cycle: ₹2,000 on online spends and ₹2,000 on offline spends.

faqs.question: Did SBI change the Cashback Card in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. From 1 April 2026, online cashback is capped at ₹2000 per statement cycle and the total at ₹4000. Digital gaming, tolls and government payments no longer earn cashback.

faqs.question: Does the SBI Cashback Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: No, it has no lounge access, domestic or international.

faqs.question: Is there an annual fee waiver on the SBI Cashback Credit Card?
faqs.answer: Yes. The annual fee of ₹999 plus GST is waived if you spend ₹2 lakh or more in a membership year.

faqs.question: Does the SBI Cashback Credit Card give cashback on utility bills and insurance?
faqs.answer: No. Utility bill payments and insurance premiums earn no cashback.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup fee on the SBI Cashback Credit Card?
Is the SBI Cashback Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The joining and annual fee is ₹999 plus GST. The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹2 lakh or more in a membership year.

faqs.question: What happens after I reach the cashback cap?
faqs.answer: Once you earn ₹2,000 in online cashback in a statement cycle, which takes ₹40,000 of online spends, further online spends earn no cashback until the next cycle. Offline spends have their own ₹2,000 cap.

faqs.question: Is the SBI Cashback Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes, if most of your spends are online and stay under ₹40,000 a month.
